records.name: Moder Patshala
records.summary: Free homework help, English classes for children and adults, and college application help, mainly for Bangladeshi-American families in West Philadelphia.
records.what_you_do: Kids and teens get homework help and writing support, adults can take English classes, and parents can get counseling. University students have volunteered as tutors.

first_step.how: Use the Contact Us link on moderpatshala.org to ask whether the after-school program has space this year
first_step.basis: Programs are free and the site has volunteer and donate pages, but it shows no sign-up steps, dates or times, and the newest dated item found is from 2016.

records.notes: IRS filing address 5558 Market St is deliberately not recorded: the 2016 University of Pennsylvania page describes a home-based program run from the founders' home, so the address may be a private residence. Owner should decide whether a public location is appropriate. A third-party directory gives a phone number and the Market St address, neither confirmed on the group's own site, so not recorded. Status is dormant because the newest program evidence found is a 2016 article; the group's own site shows only a 2012 to 2013 copyright. The group filed a Form 990-EZ for fiscal 2024 (filed November 2025, revenue $52,064). That shows it still exists, but a tax filing is not counted as dated activity. Worth a re-check of its news and events pages.

records.name: Together We Can Change
records.summary: Makes meals in a home kitchen and brings them by cart to people in need around Philadelphia, and gives out clothing and other essentials.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer at upcoming events, donate food, clothes or essentials through the group's wishlists, speak in its Speaker Series, or sponsor. People in need can ask the group for help.

cost.text: Free to volunteer; donations are optional

first_step.how: Call 215-398-2917 and ask about volunteering at the next event, or use the How can I help page on the group's website
first_step.basis: Volunteer, donation and speaker options are listed on the group's own page, with a phone number and an email address.

records.notes: Homepage and How can I help page carry no dated items; the only year is 2020, the founding year. Status is probably_active because the site works but shows no dates. The Upcoming Events and Calendar pages are linked from the site but were not read (same site fetch budget used). The IRS address 5016 Chestnut St is not recorded because meals are made in a home kitchen. The group's page also names a Coatesville wishlist, so it may serve areas beyond Philadelphia. Batch contact name is a private person's name and is not recorded.

records.name: Yah'weh's Temple
records.notes: Legal name Yah Weh S Temple Inc. The site calls the organization The Aten's Temple, Inc. The old batch address www.theatenstempleinc.org redirects to this domain, which was followed. Hidden as private because the site is a founder's teaching channel (video sermons, books for sale, donation links) with no meetings, worship schedule, classes, volunteer route or Philadelphia event found, so there is no public way in. This is not a judgment on beliefs, and no hateful content was seen. The site's email line is garbled and was not recorded. The IRS address was not recorded. Revisit if the group opens public services.

records.name: A.D.E. (Audacity to Dare to Educate)
records.summary: Pushes for fairer special education for children from groups that are often left out, and helps families see learning differences and neurodiversity in a more positive light.
records.what_you_do: Attend or host a talk, come to community events, or email the group to help with its work. The group lists speaking talks on special education on its site.

first_step.how: Email the group through the address on its website to ask about the next talk or event
first_step.basis: The site invites visitors to get involved by email and lists its events publicly, though it shows no dated events.

records.notes: The batch name was 'Ade (Audacity to Dare to Educate)'. The batch website domain redirects to a Google Sites page, which was read. The site has no dated items and its page updated field is blank, so status is probably_active on a working site with no dates. An 'a sip and a seat' event links to Eventbrite and was not read. The IRS address is an apartment and is not recorded. The email is the group's own published contact on its domain.

records.name: Charge for Change
records.summary: A nonprofit working to cut car pollution and make electric vehicle charging easier to reach in inner-city neighborhoods. Volunteers can help at local charger installs or share their stories.
records.what_you_do: Help at a charger install, share your story for its campaign, make a donation, or partner on a charging project.

first_step.how: Call the phone number on the group's website and ask about the next volunteer charger install
first_step.basis: Volunteer installs are mentioned, but the site does not say where or when they happen, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Philadelphia is not named on the group's site. The IRS filing gives a Philadelphia address (not recorded), but the listed phone has a Delaware area code. The summary makes no location claim. Confirm the group works in Philadelphia before this goes live; if it does not, change the verdict to out_of_area. The site shows only a 2025 copyright and no dated items, so status is probably_active on a working site with no dates. The email is hidden behind protection code and was not recorded.

notes: Searches: 2 of 2 used, cap reached. Fetches: 22. Verdicts: 13 publish, 1 hide (private), 1 out_of_area. Eight groups remain unknown for want of a search (Roses Clubhouse, Transient the Next Step, Virtuous Woman Ministries, Women's Interest Never Stops, A New Spirit, A Wealth of Women, Boldly Exceptional, Chaveirim); a later pass with search budget could check them. The Pillar of Hope search found no match. Its results named other Philadelphia groups (The Hope Center, HopePHL, House of Hope) that are unrelated to this batch, so they were not added as leads. Redirects followed: Yah'weh's Temple (same organization, new domain) and A.D.E. (domain to Google Sites). Tax filings (Form 990) were noted but not counted as dated activity. Addresses deliberately not recorded for Moder Patshala (home-based program, possibly a private home), Together We Can Change (meals made in a home kitchen), and A.D.E. and Be Resilient Jamaica (apartment addresses). Owner should decide whether any of these may be published. Person names from batch contact fields (officers, preparers, tax-form contacts) were not recorded. The Together We Can Change Upcoming Events and Calendar pages were linked but not read.
